follow-up time: 6 months before and after the change in guidelines in January 2015
exposure: New gestational diabetes diagnostic and therapeutic criteria
cohort: Pregnant women at a regional hospital
finding: The implementation of new gestational diabetes diagnostic and therapeutic criteria in January 2015 led to a significant increase in diagnoses and pharmacological interventions but did not significantly reduce the measured neonatal or maternal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the incidence of cesarean delivery before and after the implementation of new diagnostic and therapeutic criteria for gestational diabetes.
